text:
sara: quick one — link scanner flagged a couple 404s in the runtime examples page (kv-cache section). anyone on docs team able to take a look? I can add a quick PR if no one claims it :wave:
mike: thanks for the ping, sara. can you paste the failing urls?
sara: sure — noticed these in the scanner output: `https://internal.redwood/runtime/kv-cache#prefetch` and `https://cdn.redwood/assets/kv-cache-diagram.png`
jose: I think the first is an outdated fragment — we renamed the heading last quarter. second might be a CDN path rotation, saw similar last month.
lina: @jose yep, CDN rotation. I can rehost the diagram to /docs-assets and update the path.
mike: I can handle the fragment rename — will search for the new anchor and update the example snippet. ping me if you see other broken anchors.
sara: awesome, thanks both. mike — if you open a tiny PR I'll review quickly. lina — can you post the new hosted url here when it's up?
lina: will do. uploading to s3 now, should have a stable path in ~10m.
docs-bot: link-scanner: 2 new issues logged (id: LS-2026-447) — assigned to channel docs for triage.
mike: PR opened: `fix/docs-kv-anchors-176543` — replaces old fragment with `#kv-prefetching` and updates snippet. request review from sara.
lina: uploaded `https://cdn.redwood/docs-assets/kv-cache-diagram-v2.png` and added 301 redirect from old path. posting the link in the PR comment.
sara: checking PR/preview now. looks good on staging, image renders and anchor jumps fine. thanks! :thumbsup:
mike: merging after CI, will note in changelog.
sara: tiny follow-up — can we add a short note to the change log or docs backlog so we remember anchor churn when renaming headings? not necessary for this PR but good to track.
jose: good call. added a backlog card: "doc: anchor-stability checklist for runtime examples"
sara: perfect. thanks everyone — closing the loop. :white_check_mark:
